working_tree: Intentional uncommitted sprint state; this is local evidence, not a frozen release candidate.
scope: MongoDB browse fetch_rows derives collection type metadata and retains requested page rows from one cursor.
A MongoDB 7 failpoint changes an off-page field before it is read; later type changes in the same cursor are detected and mixed values remain read-only.
A failpoint mutation after the cursor has already read a document demonstrates best-effort, non-snapshot behavior.
The shell run_find path performs a separate census and filtered query, merges types from returned rows, and CSV/JSON export preserves materialized Extended JSON values.
A diagnostic run measures census elapsed time for 1,000 and 10,000 documents with a 50-row page.
limits: MongoDB scans do not provide snapshot isolation or optimistic conflict detection; a write may overwrite a concurrent change.
run_find cannot observe type changes to documents outside its returned page after its census.
Timings are one sample on this local container and are diagnostic only, with no pass/fail threshold.
The app-server result does not establish installed GTK or release-candidate acceptance.

regressions.assertions: MongoDB 7 failCommand blocks getMore; a native update changes off-page _id 149 to Decimal128 before the cursor reads it. Assert mixed metadata, canonical kind-preserving values for already-read rows, read-only editing, and native changed/sibling BSON postconditions.
MongoDB 7 failCommand skips the metadata find and blocks a second find. Assert the browse operation completes without that second find and returns the requested row and type metadata.
regressions.before_fix: The prior two-command regression reproduced stale string metadata after an off-page mutation; output off-page-before-fix.txt.

regressions.assertions: MongoDB 7 failpoint blocks getMore after _id 0 has been read; a native update changes String to Decimal128. Assert the page retains stale String metadata/value while native storage has Decimal128, explicitly documenting the non-snapshot boundary.

MongoDB 7 failpoint blocks run_find after its collection census; a selected row changes to Decimal128. Assert returned columns become mixed, the row retains canonical Decimal128 Extended JSON, and CSV/JSON exports preserve that marker.
Seed 1,000 and 10,000 documents, request a 50-row page, and report one elapsed full-census sample per collection without asserting timing.
